title: pg_sage - Agentic Postgres DBA
description: pg_sage, the agentic Postgres DBA: the sidecar, its databases, actions, LLM use, SRE and SLOs, and value

panels.title: Version
panels.description: pg_sage version and operating mode (pg_sage_info).

panels.title: Build
panels.description: Release and commit of the running binary (pg_sage_build_info).

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the sidecar process started.

panels.title: Control database
panels.description: Whether the sidecar reaches its control database.

panels.title: Leader
panels.description: Whether this sidecar holds each lease scope (HA).

panels.title: API certificate expires in
panels.description: Time left on the API TLS certificate served.

panels.title: Loop runs and errors
panels.description: Runs and failed runs of the periodic loops.

defaults.noValue: no data: no loop has run

panels.title: Loop last success age
panels.description: Time since each loop's last successful run.

defaults.noValue: no data: no loop has succeeded

panels.title: Metrics refresh age
panels.description: Time since each database's metrics source last refreshed. A rising line means /metrics serves stale values.

panels.title: Databases up
panels.description: Monitored databases connected with a fresh status.

panels.title: Databases down
panels.description: Monitored databases not connected or not refreshing.

panels.title: Emergency stop
panels.description: Databases held by an emergency stop (own or fleet-wide).

panels.title: Trust level
panels.description: Effective trust level of each database.

panels.title: Collector breaker
panels.description: Collector circuit breaker of each database.

panels.title: Open findings by severity
panels.description: Open findings of the selected databases.

panels.title: Collector and analyzer age
panels.description: Time since each database's last collector snapshot and analysis.

defaults.noValue: no data: no cycle has completed

panels.title: Health score
panels.description: Database health score, 0-100.

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: Database size from the collector's last snapshot.

panels.title: Time to first finding
panels.description: From start to each database's first finding.

panels.title: First look findings
panels.description: Findings of each database's catalog-only first look.

defaults.noValue: no data: first look not run

panels.title: Action outcomes
panels.description: Actions that ended, by outcome.

defaults.noValue: no data: no action has ended

panels.title: Pending approvals
panels.description: Approvals a person can act on now, by risk.

panels.title: Since last failed action
panels.description: Time since the latest failed action.

defaults.noValue: no data: no action has failed

panels.title: Verification verdicts
panels.description: Verifications finalized, by verdict.

panels.title: Policy parks
panels.description: Self-initiated changes the policy gate parked, by reason.

panels.title: Verification wait releases
panels.description: Verification waits that ended without a verdict, by cause.

panels.title: Shadow verdicts
panels.description: What the gate would have decided for classes below their earned trust.

defaults.noValue: no data: feature off (no shadow class)

panels.title: Tokens today vs budget
panels.description: LLM tokens used today against the daily budget.

panels.title: LLM circuit
panels.description: LLM circuit breaker.

panels.title: LLM enabled
panels.description: Whether the LLM integration is enabled.

panels.title: Fleet budget by database
panels.description: Fleet LLM tokens used against each allocation.

panels.title: Tuning agent tokens today
panels.description: Tuning agent tokens charged today and its cap.

panels.title: Tuning cases deferred
panels.description: Workload cases the last cycle left for later.

panels.title: SLO state
panels.description: Current error-budget state of each SLO.

panels.title: SLO burn rate
panels.description: Burn rate per window; 1 spends the budget exactly.

panels.title: Error budget left
panels.description: Share of each SLO window's error budget left.

panels.title: Investigations by state
panels.description: Sage SRE investigations by state.

panels.title: Oldest open investigation
panels.description: Age of the oldest live investigation.

panels.title: Probe slot wait
panels.description: Mean time probes waited for a probe slot.

panels.title: Probe refusals
panels.description: Probes refused a slot within the queue wait.

panels.title: Toil saved
panels.description: Net verified DBA toil saved.

panels.title: Incidents avoided
panels.description: Incidents avoided, by kind.

panels.title: Self budget exceeded
panels.description: Whether pg_sage used more than its own budget.

panels.title: pg_sage database time per hour
panels.description: Database time of pg_sage's own statements against the budget.

panels.title: pg_sage CPU per cycle
panels.description: CPU time of the sidecar per collector cycle.

panels.title: sage schema size
panels.description: Size of the sage schema in each database.

options.content: pg_sage charts the sidecar and its work, not PostgreSQL internals. For connections, cache hits, transactions, dead tuples and deadlocks, scrape [postgres_exporter](https://github.com/prometheus-community/postgres_exporter) and import the community [PostgreSQL Database dashboard](https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/9628).
